full_judgment: This rule arises out of a suit for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession in certain land. It is being contested by some of the defendants including the petitioner. At the hearing of the suit one of the plaintiff namely, Khogendra Kumar Shil was examined-in-chief but unfortunately he died before he could be cross-examined. An application was thereupon filed from the side of the petitioner for an order to have his deposition expunged as being admissible. The trial judge, by the impugned order dated 5.8.91 rejected the same. It is against this order that the petitioner obtained the present rule.
